description:
Quickly find files across your Windows PC and NAS using a full-text search engine.

With the growth of files and data in homes and workplaces, you need a modern solution to find files no matter where they’re stored. Qsirch PC Edition allows you to quickly find files across your Windows PC and NAS using a full-text search engine with keywords, tags and various filters.
[Fixed Issues]
- Improved app security by fixing potential security vulnerability.
